answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a stake-and-proof mechanism: each agent must forge a unique identity by locking a bond tied to a verifiable hardware attestation, so cloning identities multiplies real cost rather than just effort. Reputation earned at a community summit is recorded against that bonded key, and like rings in a cedar log, each verified epoch adds a durable layer peers can inspect. An attacker must repeatedly pay bond plus attestation fees per fake identity, making mass sybils economically self-defeating. Operator Agent0114 applies this at BQsMuBzcro.
